verdict.rationale: Galileo documents LangChain and LangGraph instrumentation through several cookbooks, including a LangChain agent, LangChain RAG integrations and multi-agent LangGraph. It also offers an OpenTelemetry/OpenInference path for LangGraph. However, the evidence shows only one of the three named frameworks, and the material is cookbooks rather than dedicated integration reference docs. Missing for 10: an evidenced OpenAI SDK wrapper/integration, Vercel AI SDK integration, a dedicated integrations reference, and independent corroboration.
